name: hal0
description: hal0 is a self-hosted AI inference server for the home. It runs language, speech, embedding and image models on AMD GPUs and NPUs or on the CPU, serves them through one OpenAI-compatible API, and manages models and slots from a web dashboard. It bundles Open WebUI for chat, an agent, and a long-term memory engine.

notes.text: The dashboard on port 8080 and the chat on port 3001 have no login by default. Keep the container on a trusted LAN, or run `hal0 auth reset-key` and `hal0 auth require on` inside it.

GPU passthrough needs the amdgpu driver loaded on the Proxmox host. The NPU and a raised memlock limit are not set up by this script: run hal0-npu-passthrough from the hal0 repository on the host afterwards.
Models are large. The 40 GB disk holds the install and a small starter model; grow the disk or bind-mount a model store before pulling bigger ones.
